name: io.github.kapella-hub/firekeep
description: Self-hosted memory, continuity, and coordination for AI coding agents. One MCP gateway, 104 tools.

packageArguments.description: Run the local Firekeep MCP gateway. Firekeep is self-hosted, and the kit plus a server come from one command: `curl -fsSL https://firekeep.ai/latest/install | sh` (Windows: `irm https://firekeep.ai/latest/install.ps1 | iex`). It asks for an agent identity, then where your server is — set one up on this machine, redeem a join code, point at one already running, or decide later. Install documentation: https://firekeep.ai/docs.html
